balanced.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM properties WHERE property_type = 'Self-Storage' AND status != 'Sold'

remainder.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM properties WHERE status != 'Sold' AND property_type = 'Self-Storage'

balanced.sql: SELECT SUM(current_market_value) FROM properties WHERE status != 'Sold' AND market = 'Denver'

remainder.sql: SELECT SUM(current_market_value) FROM properties WHERE status != 'Sold' AND market = 'Denver' AND status != 'Sold'

balanced.sql: SELECT p.name, ln.lender, ln.maturity_date FROM loans ln JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = ln.property_id WHERE ln.maturity_date >= '2027-01-01' AND ln.maturity_date <= '2027-12-31'

remainder.sql: SELECT p.name, l.lender, f.maturity_date FROM loans l JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = l.property_id JOIN property_financials f ON f.property_id = p.property_id WHERE f.maturity_date >= '2027-01-01' AND f.maturity_date <= '2027-12-31'

balanced.sql: SELECT name, SUM(f.net_operating_income) FROM property_financials f JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = f.property_id WHERE f.period_end > '2025-06-30' AND f.period_end <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(f.net_operating_income) DESC LIMIT 5

remainder.sql: SELECT name, SUM(f.net_operating_income) FROM property_financials f JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = f.property_id WHERE f.period_end > '2025-06-30' AND f.period_end <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY trailing_noi DESC LIMIT 5

balanced.sql: SELECT name FROM tenants WHERE is_national_tenant = 1 AND credit_rating = 'AA'

remainder.sql: SELECT name FROM tenants WHERE credit_rating = 'AA' AND is_national_tenant = 1

balanced.sql: SELECT MIN(l.leased_sqft) FROM leases l JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = l.property_id WHERE p.status != 'Sold'

remainder.sql: SELECT MIN(l.leased_sqft) FROM leases l JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = l.property_id WHERE p.status != 'Sold' AND l.status = 'Active'

balanced.sql: SELECT t.name FROM tenants t JOIN leases l ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE l.status IN ('Active', 'Holdover') ORDER BY l.leased_sqft DESC LIMIT 5

remainder.sql: SELECT t.name, l.leased_sqft FROM leases l JOIN tenants t ON t.tenant_id = l.tenant_id WHERE l.status IN ('Active', 'Holdover') ORDER BY l.leased_sqft DESC LIMIT 5

balanced.sql: SELECT p.name, ln.ltv FROM loans ln JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = ln.property_id WHERE ln.debt != 0

remainder.sql: SELECT p.name, ln.ltv FROM loans ln JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = ln.property_id WHERE ln.status != 'Sold' AND ln.ltv > 0

balanced.sql: SELECT p.market, SUM(gross_potential_rent) AS total_gross_potential_rent, SUM(f.net_operating_income) AS total_effective_gross_income FROM property_financials f JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = f.property_id WHERE f.period_end <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY p.market

remainder.sql: SELECT p.market, SUM(gross_potential_rent) AS total_gross_potential_rent, SUM(f.net_operating_income) AS total_effective_gross_income FROM property_financials f JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = f.property_id WHERE f.period_end <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.market
